trending.rankedBy: Ranked by wallets trading, trades and volume
trending.rule: Wallets other than the launcher count most; swaps in the launch block and the next {sniperBlocks} blocks are left out of that count. Trades, dollar volume and holders add on a log scale, and tokens under {freshHours} hours old get a boost. To qualify, a token needs {minTrades} trades and {minTraders} such wallets in the last hour. When fewer than {minStrip} tokens do, the board shows the last 24 hours, where {minTrades} trades and one such wallet are enough. Tokens paired with an unlisted asset are not ranked.
